decisions.reason: The spring-balanced desk lamp still has its own page and fits the ergonomic workplace portfolio, and nothing shows it falling short of aspirations.
This second-generation general interior luminaire is a recent refresh of the core business and is likely to meet aspirations set by past interior lighting performance.
The microprismatic pendant is presented as a flagship of the firm's direction, so strategic commitment and slack in the core business keep it on the market.

Withdrawing the naval lighting system signals a shortfall in the marine niche, and problemistic search makes the legacy HMI searchlight, overtaken by the LED transition, the next obvious place to free resources.
The marine searchlight line is exposed to the same marine-niche retreat that removed Product A, but it can be carried at low cost while its results remain uncertain.
